integrity: The accompanying exact-arithmetic and deterministic test program supplements an analytic global-optimality proof. It does not establish the theorem by numerical sampling. The claim is an independently stated heterogeneous-price classification, not an assertion that its basic design-theoretic tools are novel.
limitations: Finite connected simple unicyclic graphs with positive linear edge prices, continuous nonnegative conductances, and a positive budget only. No claim of independent review or exhaustive historical priority; relevant earlier equal-price cyclic designs and standard KKT tools are acknowledged.
title: Exact D-optimal conductances on heterogeneously priced unicyclic graphs
